full_details: The rehearsal at nine was on the book. You were not at it. You went back over Saturday's brawl and would not use the June streets. The margin took arrows and initials. You wrote who has a weapon and who has a buckler, who can restrain whom, and where the Prince stands. In the afternoon you played in the Knave. The journal does not hold the playing. At home after, the wives' line was still on the sheet. You did not write Thursday's hour into it.
one_sentence: You stayed home through the morning rehearsal, set the brawl's own people, and played the Knave in the afternoon.
title: The brawl's own street
